# Platform agent schema initialization, 2026-10-04

The mandatory platform-postgres job previously applied only the platform store's migration 13. Its new native OAuth/default-directory cases also require the real agent ledger 1/2/3, corresponding to 0006_agent_link.sql, 0007_agent_control.sql and 0015_agent_oauth_grants.sql. An absent agent schema must fail the lane. The separate canonical PostgreSQL lane's 322 passes and 80 requirements do not establish this platform-job prerequisite, and the prior combined platform run remains failed with 2611 passes, 21 failures and eight declared skips.

This packet adds scripts/agent/apply-schema.ts, its focused CI contract tests and this handoff, and inserts one unconditional initialization step in the existing platform-postgres job. The platform migrator, canonical agent migration registry, DDL files and schema verifier remain unchanged. The existing mandatory run, always-running report and execution-bound validator remain exact. No native requirement, backend, skip rule, source identity or successful report is added or removed. Full hosted/public Supabase migrations are not coupled into this job.

The initializer reads only ZENITH_TEST_PLATFORM_PG_URL from the environment. It accepts one explicit PostgreSQL loopback host, port, postgres username, nonempty password and simple database name. It refuses remote hosts, lists, socket targets, missing scalars, query/startup/user/database overrides and fragments before any database opener or file read. No URL is accepted through argv or .env loading. Fixed diagnostics expose no URI, password, SQL, row, role configuration or caught driver error. The actual native current user and database must match the admitted target before role writes.

Role admission is a transaction serialized under a fixed advisory lock. The only names eligible for creation are anon, authenticated and service_role. All three are NOLOGIN, NOINHERIT, nonsuperuser, nonreplicating, unable to create databases or roles, with unlimited default connection count and no expiration or role configuration. Only service_role has BYPASSRLS. Every existing named role must already match these exact attributes and have no membership involving the fixed roles. The script refuses incompatible existing roles without ALTER or DROP. It creates only absent fixed names, rereads the complete boundary before commit, and makes no production default-authority registration. These roles are disposable CI stand-ins; they prove no hosted Supabase role graph or authentication behavior.

All canonical migration texts are loaded before opening the database and passed unchanged to the locked driver in registry order. Versions 1 and 2 run in individual driver transactions. Canonical 0015 already contains BEGIN/COMMIT and therefore executes in its own existing native transaction; its bytes and transaction boundaries are preserved. On failure the script attempts rollback, closes its own client and returns a fixed failed verdict. It does not claim one atomic commit across every migration, nor does it delete an already committed schema on later failure. The job's whole disposable database is the cleanup boundary. Reapplication of 0006/0007's historical all-table grants is always followed by canonical 0015's restrictions before any test can launch.

Success requires the actual exported verifyAgentSchema and an exact ordered ledger matching AGENT_CONTROL_MIGRATIONS, then successful client closure. This verifier checks canonical OAuth structure, constraints, index properties, identity trigger and function semantics, RLS, service/client privileges and known names. The historical agent ledger has no checksums; this packet invents none. The existing platform checksum verifier and migrator remain independent. The executable entrypoint always uses the genuine locked client, committed files and real verifier. Its exported orchestration seam exists only for explicitly modeled script tests and does not provide a production authority constructor or bypass CLI target validation.

Focused tests cover loopback admission and hosted/list/socket/startup/user/database refusals before IO, actual locked Node/tsx module linkage with an invalid target before credentials or sockets, incompatible roles and membership, unchanged canonical SQL delivery and transaction shape, native identity refusal, missing files, migration/verifier/ledger/closure failure, private diagnostics and the real mandatory workflow ordering. SQL catalog replies and successful verifier execution are explicit protocol models. They supply no native or hosted proof. Root must independently run the actual fresh-role setup, repeat initialization, canonical schema/ACL verifier and tampered-schema/role-collision refusals against positively owned PostgreSQL 16.15.

All author project imports, tests, compiler, lint, services, database and container execution, installs and commits are unrun. Independent source review remains required before root integration. Root must run the focused tests and cold physical initializer, then the complete canonical platform lane with its exact mandatory identities. The six genuine default-membership grant cases and the 95 OAuth/61 linked source controls remain required; previously passing native subsets do not turn the failed whole platform report green. Root's separate PostgreSQL and platform lanes must use fresh owned containers serially, preserving cluster-role rollback tests and resource cleanup.

Root invocation uses the private environment target and the locked installed runtime:

```sh
node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/agent/apply-schema.ts
node scripts/ci/run-gate.mjs platform-postgres --run
node scripts/ci/run-gate.mjs platform-postgres --validate .data-ci-lane/platform-lane.json --require-execution
```

Actual hosted topology, OAuth/browser transport, worker dispatch, provider writes and complete packaged acceptance remain separate release work. This initialization establishes none of those outcomes by inspection.
